meta.name: Mission Breaking News
meta.description:
Murder of Vidya Naik, a prominent and honest journalist, has shocked the nation. Her son, Nischal Naik together with his friends risks it all to investigate the murder and find the killer. But all they do is get into deeper trouble with danger looming around them!

Returning Series · First aired 5 Oct 2019 · India · Language: Hindi · 20 min

Complete series. On your server: S1 12/12

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Vidya Naik, an honest and prominent journalist is mudered. The killer is at large and the media circus jumps at the opportunity to milk the situation and get TRP.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Dhiraj is fabricating news to misguide the people. Nischal is trying to follow up with the police reagrding his mother's case but is left disappointed and humiliated by Inspector kamble. Nischal looks for his mother's laptop but can't find it anywhere!

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Vidya's laptop was hacked and all her important files leading to exposng a huge scam were encrypted. Nischal has to find the hacker who had encrypted the files!

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Ejaz and Nischal catch Walter who hacked Vidya's laptop. Scared and ashamed, he gives them the password for Vidya’s documents. Ejaz and Nischal go through Vidya’s laptop and discover some shocking evidences!

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Simone, a corporate lawyer and Nischal’s ex girlfriend, visits Nischal. Ejaz convinces her to help them with legal matters. Walter shows up as he wants to set the record straight and wants to help them with any technical stuff they need. Later that night, Nischal is haunted by blank calls!

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Upendra knows about the four trying to start Kranti again. Nischal, Ejaz, Walter and Simone are going through video and audio files on Vidya’s laptop. They suspect something fishy going on in that village. At that moment warning shots are fired at his house!

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Walter is unconscious and is in the ICU. Inspector Kamble, arrests Ejaz and takes him to the lock up and manhandles him. Nischal is on his way to the airport to fly back to Canada, Ejaz is behind bars, Simone is back to desk job. The Kranti team has fallen apart!

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Nischal, Ejaz and Simone decide to investigate the case and expose the real killers. They travel to the village but no one is ready to speak to them. Chakuli, a villager gives them some important information but then they are caught by Upendra's goons!

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: As Nischal, Ejaz and Chakuli are caught by Upendra’s goons, while searching for evidence against him, he orders his men to test new batch of medicines on them.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Nischal and Ejaz after a fight they manage to escape, meanwhile frustrated Upendra tries to cover up the damage and calls Dhiraj to start a smear campaign against Nischal, Ejaz, Walter and Simone.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: As the News gets published on Kranti portal, Upendra is now behind bars and asks his PA to get him out, while Nischal, Ejaz, Walter, Simone visits Upendra him.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: After hearing about Upendra’s death, Nischal gets a call from Mr. Iyer who offers him to buy the Kranti news portal.
